name: strahd von zarovich
lore:
Strahd von Zarovich is not merely a tenant of Barovia; he is its soul and its cage. As the first vampire, his ecology is inextricably linked to the valley's cursed mists. He feeds not only on the blood of the living but on the cyclic despair of those trapped within his borders. He is the apex predator of a closed system, commanding the wolves, the bats, and the very storm clouds that choke the sun.

In behavior, the Count is a study in cold, predatory patience. He does not hunt with the mindless hunger of a common ghoul; he orchestrates. He views adventurers as fleeting curiosities—playthings meant to alleviate the crushing boredom of centuries. He is a master tactician who prefers to erode a hero’s resolve before claiming their life. Do not mistake his courtly grace for mercy; it is the velvet glove hiding an ancient, iron-hearted malice.
